shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
shield_bash.description: Attack. On a hit the target makes a Defense save or is stunned (loses its next turn).

poison_arrow.name: Poison Arrow
poison_arrow.description: Attack. On a hit the target makes a Defense save or is poisoned (1 damage a turn for 3 turns).

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: No attack roll: every monster makes a Speed save. Fail: full damage and burning (2 a turn for 2 turns). Pass: half damage.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.description: Two attacks this turn, each at -2 to hit.

iron_guard.name: Iron Guard
iron_guard.description: No attack. You gain Shield 6: it blocks the next 6 damage.

aimed_shot.name: Aimed Shot
aimed_shot.description: Attack with advantage (roll two d20, keep the higher). +1d6 damage on a hit.

frost_bolt.name: Frost Bolt
frost_bolt.description: Attack. On a hit the target makes a Speed save or is frozen (stunned: loses its next turn).

uppercut.name: Uppercut
uppercut.description: Attack at -2 to hit, +1d8 damage on a hit.

piercing_thrust.name: Piercing Thrust
piercing_thrust.description: Attack at +2 to hit, +1d4 damage on a hit.

sweeping_arc.name: Sweeping Arc
sweeping_arc.description: No attack roll: every monster makes a Speed save. Fail: d6 damage. Pass: half damage.

shield_wall.name: Shield Wall
shield_wall.description: No attack. You and your allies gain Shield 6.

judgement.name: Judgement
judgement.description: Attack with advantage, +1d6 damage. On a hit the target makes a Defense save or is stunned.

reckless_swing.name: Reckless Swing
reckless_swing.description: Attack at -2 to hit, +1d10 damage on a hit.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.description: Three attacks this turn, each at -3 to hit.

twin_shot.name: Twin Shot
twin_shot.description: Two attacks this turn, each at -1 to hit.

snare_trap.name: Snare Trap
snare_trap.description: Attack. On a hit the target makes a Speed save or is caught (stunned: loses its next turn).

deadeye.name: Deadeye
deadeye.description: Attack with advantage at +2 to hit, +1d8 damage on a hit.

pinning_shot.name: Pinning Shot
pinning_shot.description: Attack. On a hit the target makes a Defense save or is pinned (stunned: loses its next turn).

thunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm
thunderstorm.description: No attack roll: every monster makes a Speed save. Fail: d12 damage. Pass: half damage.

flame_lance.name: Flame Lance
flame_lance.description: Attack, +1d6 damage. On a hit the target makes a Speed save or burns (2 a turn for 2 turns).

hex_bolt.name: Hex Bolt
hex_bolt.description: Attack with advantage, +1d8 damage on a hit.

curse_of_rot.name: Curse of Rot
curse_of_rot.description: Attack. On a hit the target makes a Defense save or rots (poison 2 a turn for 3 turns).

palm_strike.name: Palm Strike
palm_strike.description: Attack, +1d6 damage. On a hit the target makes a Defense save or is stunned.

headbutt.name: Headbutt
headbutt.description: Attack, +1d4 damage. On a hit the target makes a Defense save or is stunned.

haymaker.name: Haymaker
haymaker.description: Attack at -3 to hit, +1d12 damage on a hit.

leap_strike.name: Leap Strike
leap_strike.description: Attack with advantage, +1d8 damage on a hit.

spear_wall.name: Spear Wall
spear_wall.description: No attack. You and your allies gain Shield 4.

impale.name: Impale
impale.description: Attack, +1d8 damage. On a hit the target makes a Defense save or is stunned.

howl.name: Howl
howl.description: Inspires its hero: +{power} to hit and damage on the next 2 attacks.

warm_egg.name: Warm Egg
warm_egg.description: Gives its hero a warm egg: heals {power} HP (only when the hero is hurt that much).

charge.name: Charge
charge.description: Attack with +1d4 damage. A critical hit also stuns.

keen_sight.name: Keen Sight
keen_sight.description: Spots an opening: its hero's next attack rolls with advantage.

snatch.name: Snatch
snatch.description: Attack. A hit also steals 1-3 gold, times {power}.

fire_breath.name: Fire Breath
fire_breath.description: No attack roll: every monster makes a Speed save. Fail: full damage and burning (2 a turn for 2 turns). Pass: half damage.
